title: salvia haematodes subsp. tiberina
intro: Salvia haematodes subsp. tiberina, commonly known as Alpine Red Sage, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the sage family native to the European Alps. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, stress, and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Salvia haematodes subsp. tiberina are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including rosmarinic acid, camphor, and borneol, which have been shown to exhibit sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. While more research is needed, Salvia haematodes subsp. tiberina has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation and improve sleep quality.
